source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Unit 6 (PDF 93-127), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 6 (Sequences and Series) ke poore unit se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke Section-II ke sawal ke hisse ki shakal mein: har sawal 5 number ka hai (lamba sawal, saboot (proof) ya derivation). Har sawal poore qadmon ke saath hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 The \(4\)th term of an A.P. is \(14\) and its \(11\)th term is \(42\). Find the general term and the \(25\)th term. Is \(150\) a term of this A.P.? (5 marks)
(Aik A.P. ka \(4\)tha term \(14\) aur \(11\)waan term \(42\) hai. General term aur \(25\)waan term maloom karein. Kya \(150\) is A.P. ka term hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono diye gaye terms \(a_{n} = a_{1} + (n - 1)d\) se likhein, \(a_{1}\) aur \(d\) hal karein, phir \(150\) ko jaanchein.

book_ref.quote: The \(n\)th term of an arithmetic progression can be written as:

blocks.prompt:
2 Show that \(a, b, c\) are in A.P. if and only if \(2b = a + c\). Hence find \(k\) if \(k + 2,\ 4k - 6,\ 3k - 2\) are in A.P., and write the three terms. (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein sirf aur sirf tab hain jab \(2b = a + c\). Is se \(k\) maloom karein agar \(k + 2,\ 4k - 6,\ 3k - 2\) A.P. mein hon, aur teeno terms likhein.)
blocks.explanation: A.P. mein saath wale farq barabar hote hain; is se shart dono taraf sabit hoti hai. Phir use lagayein.

book_ref.quote: Three numbers \(a, b, c\) are in A.P. if and only if

steps: Agar \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein hon to \(b - a = d = c - b\)
Is liye \(b - a = c - b \Rightarrow 2b = a + c\)
Ulta, agar \(2b = a + c\) ho to \(b - a = c - b\): farq barabar hain, is liye \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein hain.
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(a, b, c\) A.P. mein \(\Leftrightarrow 2b = a + c\); \(k = 3\), terms \(5, 6, 7\).

blocks.prompt:
3 Find four numbers in A.P. whose sum is \(20\) and the sum of whose squares is \(120\). (5 marks)
(A.P. mein aise chaar numbers maloom karein jin ka jama \(20\) aur un ke squares ka jama \(120\) ho.)
blocks.explanation: Terms \(a - 3d, a - d, a + d, a + 3d\) lein taake jama se foran \(a\) mil jaye.

book_ref.quote: Four consecutive terms of an A.P. may be written as

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yahan common difference \(2d = 2\) hai, \(d\) nahi; \(a - 3d, a - d, a + d, a + 3d\) mein har farq \(2d\) hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
4 The sum of three numbers in A.P. is \(15\) and the sum of their squares is \(83\). Find the numbers. (5 marks)
(A.P. mein teen numbers ka jama \(15\) aur un ke squares ka jama \(83\) hai. Numbers maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(a - d, a, a + d\) lein; jama se \(a\), squares se \(d\) milega.

5 Insert six A.M.s between \(-5\) and \(16\). (5 marks)
(\(-5\) aur \(16\) ke darmiyan chhe A.M.s dalein.)
blocks.explanation: Chhe means ke saath A.P. ke \(8\) terms hain, is liye \(16\) \(8\)waan term hai; \(d\) nikal kar baar baar jama karein.

book_ref.quote: Inserting \(n\) A.M.s between \(a\) and \(b\) means filling the gap

blocks.prompt:
6 Derive the formula \(S_{n} = \frac{n}{2}[2a_{1} + (n - 1)d]\) for the sum of the first \(n\) terms of an arithmetic series. (5 marks)
(Arithmetic series ke pehle \(n\) terms ke jama ka formula \(S_{n} = \frac{n}{2}[2a_{1} + (n - 1)d]\) derive karein.)
blocks.explanation: Jama ko aage se aur peeche se likh kar jama karein: har jora \(a_{1} + \ell\) deta hai.

book_ref.quote: To develop a formula for the sum of any arithmetic series

steps: Aage se: \(S_{n} = a_{1} + (a_{1} + d) + (a_{1} + 2d) + \cdots + (\ell - d) + \ell\), jahan \(\ell = a_{n}\)
Term-ba-term jama: har jora \(a_{1} + \ell\) hai, aur \(n\) jore hain

blocks.prompt:
7 How many terms of the series \(20 + 18 + 16 + \cdots\) amount to \(110\)? Explain why there are two answers. (5 marks)
(Series \(20 + 18 + 16 + \cdots\) ke kitne terms ka jama \(110\) hai? Wazeh karein ke do jawab kyun hain.)
blocks.explanation: \(n\) maloom nahi, is liye \(S_{n} = \frac{n}{2}[2a_{1} + (n - 1)d]\) lagayein aur \(n\) ki quadratic hal karein.

book_ref.quote: If \(n\) is the unknown, the second form gives a quadratic

steps: \(a_{11} = 20 + 10(-2) = 0\), is liye \(11\)waan term jama karne se jama nahi badalta

blocks.prompt:
8 The sum of the first \(7\) terms of an A.P. is \(63\) and its \(10\)th term is \(21\). Find the series and the sum of its first \(20\) terms. (5 marks)
(Aik A.P. ke pehle \(7\) terms ka jama \(63\) aur \(10\)waan term \(21\) hai. Series aur us ke pehle \(20\) terms ka jama maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono sharton ko \(a_{1}\) aur \(d\) ki equations bana kar ikatthay hal karein.

book_ref.quote: given any three, the other two can be found

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the number and the sum of all two-digit numbers that are divisible by \(6\). (5 marks)
(Un tamam do hindsi (two-digit) numbers ki tadaad aur jama maloom karein jo \(6\) se poore taqseem hote hain.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh numbers A.P. \(12, 18, \ldots, 96\) banate hain; aakhri term se \(n\), phir jama nikalein.

book_ref.quote: If the last term \(a_n\) is known, use

steps: \(6\) ka sab se chhota do hindsi multiple: \(12\); sab se bara: \(96\)

blocks.prompt:
10 The \(2\)nd term of a G.P. is \(-6\) and its \(5\)th term is \(48\). Find the G.P., its general term and its \(8\)th term. (5 marks)
(Aik G.P. ka \(2\)ra term \(-6\) aur \(5\)waan term \(48\) hai. G.P., us ka general term aur \(8\)waan term maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono terms \(a_{1}r^{n-1}\) se likhein; taqseem se \(a_{1}\) khatam ho kar \(r\) ki power bachti hai.

book_ref.quote: which is the general term of a G.P.

blocks.prompt:
11 If \(a, b, c\) are in G.P., prove that \(a^{2}, b^{2}, c^{2}\) are in G.P. and that \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}, \frac{1}{c}\) are in G.P. (5 marks)
(Agar \(a, b, c\) G.P. mein hon to sabit karein ke \(a^{2}, b^{2}, c^{2}\) G.P. mein hain aur \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}, \frac{1}{c}\) bhi G.P. mein hain.)
blocks.explanation: Test lagayein: non-zero \(x, y, z\) G.P. mein sirf tab hain jab \(y^{2} = xz\).

book_ref.quote: The reciprocals of the terms of a G.P. also form a G.P.

steps: \(a, b, c\) G.P. mein (sab non-zero) \(\Rightarrow b^{2} = ac\)
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(a^{2}, b^{2}, c^{2}\) aur \(\frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{b}, \frac{1}{c}\) G.P. mein hain.

blocks.prompt:
12 If positive numbers \(a, b, c\) are in G.P., prove that \(\log a, \log b, \log c\) are in A.P. Use it to show that \(\log 3, \log 12, \log 48\) are in A.P. (5 marks)
(Agar positive numbers \(a, b, c\) G.P. mein hon to sabit karein ke \(\log a, \log b, \log c\) A.P. mein hain. Is se dikhayein ke \(\log 3, \log 12, \log 48\) A.P. mein hain.)
blocks.explanation: \(b^{2} = ac\) ka log lein aur A.P. ka test \(2y = x + z\) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: are also in A.P. and vice-versa

steps: \(a, b, c\) G.P. mein \(\Rightarrow b^{2} = ac\) (sab positive, is liye logs maujood)
Is liye \(\log a, \log b, \log c\) A.P. mein hain (common difference \(\log r\))
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua; \(\log 3, \log 12, \log 48\) A.P. mein hain, common difference \(\log 4\).

blocks.prompt:
13 Insert three real geometric means between \(3\) and \(48\). (5 marks)
(\(3\) aur \(48\) ke darmiyan teen real geometric means dalein.)
blocks.explanation: G.P. ke paanch terms, is liye \(48 = 3r^{4}\); \(r\) ki sirf real qeematein lein.

14 The A.M. of two positive numbers is \(13\) and their positive G.M. is \(12\). Find the numbers and verify that \(A > G\). (5 marks)
(Do positive numbers ka A.M. \(13\) aur positive G.M. \(12\) hai. Numbers maloom karein aur tasdeeq karein ke \(A > G\).)
blocks.explanation: \(a + b = 2A\) aur \(ab = G^{2}\); numbers \(x^{2} - 2Ax + G^{2} = 0\) ke roots hain.

blocks.prompt:
15 Derive the formula \(S_{n} = \frac{a_{1}(1 - r^{n})}{1 - r}\), \(r \ne 1\), for the sum of the first \(n\) terms of a geometric series. What is \(S_{n}\) when \(r = 1\)? (5 marks)
(Geometric series ke pehle \(n\) terms ke jama ka formula \(S_{n} = \frac{a_{1}(1 - r^{n})}{1 - r}\), \(r \ne 1\), derive karein. \(r = 1\) par \(S_{n}\) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(S_{n}\) aur \(rS_{n}\) likh kar tafreeq karein: tamam darmiyani terms kat jate hain.

book_ref.quote: To develop a formula for the sum of any geometric series

steps: Agar \(r = 1\) ho to har term \(a_{1}\) hai: \(S_{n} = a_{1} + a_{1} + \cdots + a_{1} = na_{1}\)

blocks.prompt:
16 The \(2\)nd term of a G.P. is \(6\) and its \(5\)th term is \(-48\). Find the first term and the sum of the first \(8\) terms. (5 marks)
(Aik G.P. ka \(2\)ra term \(6\) aur \(5\)waan term \(-48\) hai. Pehla term aur pehle \(8\) terms ka jama maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono terms ko taqseem kar ke \(r\), phir \(a_{1}\), phir jama ka formula.

blocks.prompt:
17 Find the sum to \(n\) terms of the series \((2 + 3) + (4 + 9) + (8 + 27) + \cdots\) (5 marks)
(Series \((2 + 3) + (4 + 9) + (8 + 27) + \cdots\) ka \(n\) terms tak jama maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Series ko do geometric series mein taqseem karein aur har aik ka jama \(S_{n} = \frac{a_{1}(r^{n} - 1)}{r - 1}\) se nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Use it when \(r > 1\) so that both brackets stay positive

steps: \(S_{n} = (2 + 4 + 8 + \cdots \text{ to } n \text{ terms}) + (3 + 9 + 27 + \cdots \text{ to } n \text{ terms})\)

blocks.prompt:
18 Sum to \(n\) terms the series \(1 + 4 \cdot 3 + 7 \cdot 3^{2} + 10 \cdot 3^{3} + \cdots\) (5 marks)
(Series \(1 + 4 \cdot 3 + 7 \cdot 3^{2} + 10 \cdot 3^{3} + \cdots\) ka \(n\) terms tak jama maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: A.P. hissa \(1, 4, 7, \ldots\) aur G.P. hissa \(1, 3, 3^{2}, \ldots\): \(r = 3\) se zarb, tafreeq, G.P. ka jama.

book_ref.quote: Learn the method; it works for every A.G.P.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tafreeq ke baad A.P. hisson ka farq \(d = 3\) har power ke saath aata hai, is liye braces se pehle \(3\) common liya. Darmiyani G.P. ke \(n - 1\) terms hain (\(3\) se \(3^{n-1}\) tak).

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the sum to \(n\) terms of \(1 + 3x + 5x^{2} + 7x^{3} + \cdots\) (\(x \ne 1\)), and deduce the sum to infinity when \(|x| < 1\). (5 marks)
(\(1 + 3x + 5x^{2} + 7x^{3} + \cdots\) (\(x \ne 1\)) ka \(n\) terms tak jama maloom karein, aur \(|x| < 1\) par sum to infinity nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: A.P. hissa \(1, 3, 5, \ldots\) (\(d = 2\)), G.P. hissa \(1, x, x^{2}, \ldots\): \(x\) se zarb, tafreeq, phir \(n \to \infty\).

20 Find the sum to infinity of the series \(1 + \frac{4}{5} + \frac{7}{5^{2}} + \frac{10}{5^{3}} + \cdots\) (5 marks)
(Series \(1 + \frac{4}{5} + \frac{7}{5^{2}} + \frac{10}{5^{3}} + \cdots\) ka sum to infinity maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: A.G.P. ke \(a, d, b, r\) pehchanein, \(|r| < 1\) jaanchein, phir \(S_{\infty} = \frac{ab}{1 - r} + \frac{dbr}{(1 - r)^{2}}\) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: which is the required sum to infinity of arithmetico-geometric series

(Aik H.P. ka \(3\)ra term \(\frac{1}{7}\) aur \(8\)waan term \(\frac{1}{17}\) hai. H.P., us ka \(n\)th term aur \(20\)waan term maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: H.P. terms ko A.P. terms (reciprocals) mein badlein, \(a_{1}\) aur \(d\) hal karein, phir wapas ulta karein.

blocks.prompt:
22 Prove that the harmonic mean between \(a\) and \(b\) is \(H = \frac{2ab}{a + b}\). Find the H.M. between \(4\) and \(6\) and check that the three numbers are in H.P. (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(a\) aur \(b\) ka harmonic mean \(H = \frac{2ab}{a + b}\) hai. \(4\) aur \(6\) ka H.M. maloom karein aur jaanchein ke teeno numbers H.P. mein hain.)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{1}{H}\) \(\frac{1}{a}\) aur \(\frac{1}{b}\) ka A.M. hai; aakhir mein reciprocal lein.

book_ref.quote: Let \(a, b\) be the two numbers and \(H\) be their H.M.

steps: \(a, H, b\) H.P. mein \(\Rightarrow \frac{1}{a}, \frac{1}{H}, \frac{1}{b}\) A.P. mein
blocks.final_answer: Sabit hua: \(H = \frac{2ab}{a + b}\); \(4\) aur \(6\) ka H.M. \(\frac{24}{5}\) hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 Insert four harmonic means between \(\frac{2}{3}\) and \(\frac{2}{13}\). (5 marks)
(\(\frac{2}{3}\) aur \(\frac{2}{13}\) ke darmiyan chaar harmonic means dalein.)
blocks.explanation: Reciprocals \(\frac{3}{2}\) aur \(\frac{13}{2}\) ke darmiyan chaar A.M.s dalein, phir reciprocals lein.

book_ref.quote: then take their reciprocals to get \(n\) H.Ms. between \(a\) and \(b\)

blocks.prompt:
24 Using \(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\left[k^{m} - (k - 1)^{m}\right] = n^{m}\), prove that \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\). (5 marks)
(\(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\left[k^{m} - (k - 1)^{m}\right] = n^{m}\) ko istemal kar ke sabit karein ke \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\).)
blocks.explanation: Identity \(k^{2} - (k - 1)^{2} = 2k - 1\) lein aur dono taraf jama karein (\(m = 2\) ke saath telescoping).

book_ref.quote: and shall use this result to find out formulae for three expressions stated above

blocks.prompt:
25 Prove that \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} k^{2} = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\). (5 marks)
(Sabit karein ke \(\sum_{k=1}^{n} k^{2} = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\).)
blocks.explanation: Telescoping natije mein \(m = 3\) lein aur \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\) aur \(\sum 1 = n\) istemal karein.

blocks.explanation: Dono factors A.P.s hain: \(T_{k} = k(2k + 1)\). Kholein, sigma alag karein aur formulas lagayein.

(Us series ka \(n\) terms tak jama maloom karein jis ka \(n\)th term \(n^{2} + n + 2\) hai.)
blocks.explanation: Term ko \(k\) se likhein, sigma alag karein aur \(\sum k^{2}, \sum k, \sum 1\) lagayein.

(Series \(2^{2} + 4^{2} + 6^{2} + \cdots\) ka \(n\) terms tak jama maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bases \(2, 4, 6, \ldots\) A.P. hain jis ka \(k\)th term \(2k\) hai; is liye \(T_{k} = 4k^{2}\).

blocks.prompt:
29 A gym charges Rs. \(2000\) for the first month and increases the fee by Rs. \(150\) each month. Find (i) the fee in the \(18\)th month, (ii) the total paid in \(18\) months, (iii) the first month in which the fee is more than Rs. \(4000\). (5 marks)
(Aik gym pehle mahine Rs. \(2000\) leta hai aur har mahine fee Rs. \(150\) barhata hai. Maloom karein: (i) \(18\)wein mahine ki fee, (ii) \(18\) mahinon mein kul adayegi, (iii) woh pehla mahina jis mein fee Rs. \(4000\) se zyada ho.)
blocks.explanation: Mustaqil izafa A.P. deta hai: (i) aik term, (ii) jama, (iii) \(n\) ke liye inequality.

book_ref.quote: Does the question want one particular term or the total (sum)?

(Sara pehle mahine Rs. \(1000\) bachati hai aur har mahine pichle se Rs. \(200\) zyada. Mahinon ki sab se bari tadaad \(n\) maloom karein jis tak us ki kul bachat \(S_{n}\) Rs. \(30000\) se zyada na ho.)
blocks.explanation: Na-maloom \(n\) ke saath \(S_{n} \le 30000\) quadratic inequality deta hai; sab se bara poora number lein jo shart poori kare.
